segments.tha-ap484:4.1: “Mama aññataro sisso, sissānaṃ so kathesi me;
segments.tha-ap484:4.3: Sutvāna te etamatthaṃ, ārocesuṃ mamaṃ tadā.
segments.tha-ap484:5.3: Tassānuvattati jano, lābho amhaṃ na vijjati [na hessati (sī. pī.)].
segments.tha-ap484:8.3: Vāyasānaṃ yathā khīraṃ, dullabho lokanāyako [dullabhā lokanāyakā (sī.), dullabhaṃ lokanāyakaṃ (syā. pī. ka.)].
segments.tha-ap484:10.1: “Buddho loke samuppanno, cakkhuṃ lacchāma no bhavaṃ;
segments.tha-ap484:11.3: Te jaṭā bhārabharitā, nikkhamuṃ vipinā tadā.
segments.tha-ap484:17.1: “Svāgataṃ vata me āsi … pe … kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.tha-ap484:19.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā buddhasaññako thero imā gāthāyo Abhāsitthāti.

lines: Dutiyāpadāne adhiccuppattikā buddhāti adhiccena akāraṇena uppattikā sayambhūtā, aññehi devabrahmamārādīhi upadesadāyakehi rahitā sayambhūñāṇena uppannā jātā pātubhūtāti attho.
Odumbarikapupphaṃ vāti udumbararukkhe pupphaṃ dullabhaṃ dullabhuppattikaṃ iva.
Candamhi sasakaṃ yathāti candamaṇḍale sasalekhāya rūpaṃ dullabhaṃ yathā.

Vāyasānaṃ yathā khīranti kākānaṃ niccaṃ rattindivaṃ khuddāpīḷitabhāvena khīraṃ dullabhaṃ yathā, evaṃ dullabhaṃ lokanāyakaṃ caturāsaṅkhyeyyaṃ vā aṭṭhāsaṅkhyeyyaṃ vā soḷasāsaṅkhyeyyaṃ vā kappasatasahassaṃ pāramiyo pūretvā buddhabhāvato dullabho lokanāyakoti attho.
